items.title: Charles Tolliver interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 6, 2021 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: brought about by dearly departed Stanley Cowell and myself

ctx.x: Well thanks for sharing your opinions about that. I was very happy to learn from you on the phone about the upcoming celebration of Strata-East Records. And could you tell me a little bit about that?

Well things got up and running in 1971, you know, brought about by dearly departed Stanley Cowell and myself. And it was probably at the right moment that something like that could be done. Because there was a vacuum that had been created for bringing on new guys into recording and getting them out there like it was with the Blue Notes and Prestiges and all the other smaller independent labels who were issuing product. And it sort of was a labor of love so to speak, and just little by little you know it started…
